s1.syndrome_frame: Acute pruritic skin eruption with vesicles and erythema following sun exposure
salient_findings: Erythema and helical thickening with numerous small blisters on ears
Vesicles at the upper and lower vermillion border
key_facts: 13-year-old boy presented with skin eruption
Eruption appeared 24 hours after intensive sun exposure
Patient reported malaise and headache 2 weeks before presentation
No history of photosensitivity
No use of topical or systemic photosensitizers
Laboratory tests showed detectable serum parvovirus B19 IgM and IgG antibodies
PVB19 DNA found in lesional skin biopsy specimen
Standard phototesting with UV-A and UV-B was unremarkable
Erythematous papules and crusts located on cheeks, neck, and lower arms

shortlist.label: erythema multiforme
shortlist.why_kept: matches the clinical presentation of skin eruption with vesicles and erythema following sun exposure

shortlist.label: acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis
shortlist.why_kept: consistent with the sudden onset of skin eruption after sun exposure

shortlist.label: bullous pemphigoid
shortlist.why_kept: characterized by blistering skin lesions, which are present in this case

shortlist.label: dermatitis herpetiformis
shortlist.why_kept: presents with intensely pruritic skin lesions and vesicles, similar to this case

shortlist.label: parvovirus B19 infection
shortlist.why_kept: detectable serum parvovirus B19 IgM and IgG antibodies and PVB19 DNA found in lesional skin biopsy specimen

raw.rationale: The presence of PVB19 DNA in the lesional skin biopsy specimen and detectable serum parvovirus B19 IgM and IgG antibodies strongly support this diagnosis, which is consistent with the patient's symptoms of skin eruption and history of malaise and headache.

rejected.label: erythema multiforme
rejected.why: While the patient presents with skin eruption, the presence of PVB19 DNA and antibodies points more specifically to parvovirus B19 infection.

rejected.label: acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms do not include pustules, which are characteristic of this condition.

rejected.label: bullous pemphigoid
rejected.why: The patient's age and the absence of typical bullous pemphigoid symptoms make this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: dermatitis herpetiformis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory findings do not align with the characteristic findings of dermatitis herpetiformis, such as IgA deposits in the skin.
